title: Design Engineer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Design Engineer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Interaction Design & Micro-Animations: Crafting fluid animations, gesture handling, physics-based springs, and polished micro-interactions.
2. Design System Architecture: Building composable, accessible (WAI-ARIA) component libraries with robust design tokens and theme support.
3. Web & Client Rendering Performance: Frame rate budget (60/120fps), GPU acceleration (compositing layers, CSS transforms), and bundle optimization.
4. Bridge Between Design & Engineering: Translating Figma designs into production-ready code with pixel perfection.
